تشتووا (form VIII)
# تَشْتَوُوا (taštawū) /taʃ.ta.wuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَوَى (ištawā)
# تُشْتَوَوْا (tuštawaw) /tuʃ.ta.waw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَوَى (ištawā)
